chunks.title: What culture can include
chunks.content: Culture includes shared traditions, food, music, stories, and ways of life.
chunks.simulationHint: Choose examples that belong to a shared culture.

evidenceSpans.text: traditions, foods, music, stories, and ways of life shared by a group

assessment.subject: Reading
assessment.prompt: Which word means traditions, foods, music, stories, and shared ways of life?
assessment.explanation: Culture is the matching vocabulary word.
assessment.hint: Think about shared traditions and ways of life.
